## SharedElement.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `name` :: The shared-element name. Must be unique on the page at transition time.
- `as` :: The element tag to render as.
- `children` :: The content that morphs.

## morph.ts

### `interface MorphOptions`

Options for {@link morph}.

- `type` :: The transition style. Defaults to `'fade'`.
- `origin` :: Origin for the `'reveal'` wipe: a point, a pointer event, or an element's centre.

### `function morph`

Run an in-page state change inside a view transition, so elements that share a `SharedElement` name (and anything else in the snapshot) morph from their old box to their new one. Falls back to applying `update` directly when the API is missing or reduced motion is on. @param update The state change to apply (for example `() => (selected = card)`). @param options `type` and optional `origin` (used by `'reveal'`).
